1 · Intro

When to use it.

FMLA gives eligible employees up to 12 workweeks of job-protected leave in a 12-month period for qualifying reasons. TMLA, the Tennessee Maternity Leave Act (now the Tennessee Parental Leave Act), gives eligible employees up to four months for adoption, pregnancy, childbirth, and nursing an infant.

How you enter the leave in Oracle depends on whether it is continuous or intermittent, so get that right first.

Use this whenYou have an approved FMLA or TMLA leave and need to record it in Oracle.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle Absence Management. Check off each step as you go.

Continuous vs. intermittent vs. reduced schedule
TypeWhat it looks likeHow you enter it
ContinuousOne unbroken block of time offOne absence, start and end dates
IntermittentSeparate blocks for one reason (e.g., treatments)One absence per occurrence, actual time
Reduced scheduleFewer hours per day or weekActual hours missed, per day or week

Watch-outs

  • Intermittent leave entered as one long block overstates the time used. Enter only the time actually taken.
  • Open item: which Oracle absence types Vanderbilt uses for FMLA, TMLA (TPLA), and FMLA running at the same time as state leave, and who enters intermittent occurrences, must be confirmed.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's leave process is pending review by Sheila, the Leave SME.

HCM Academy job aid · Leave Management

Entering and managing FMLA/TMLA transactions (continuous vs. intermittent)

Use when: You have an approved FMLA or TMLA leave and need to record it in Oracle. · System: Oracle Absence Management

  1. Confirm the approval and how the leave will be taken: continuous, intermittent, or reduced schedule.
    • Continuous: one start and end date
    • Intermittent or reduced: record time as it is taken
  2. Open Add Absence for the employee and pick the absence type that matches the approval.
  3. Continuous: enter one absence with the approved start and end dates.
  4. Intermittent or reduced schedule: enter each occurrence with the actual time taken.
  5. Attach supporting documents if the absence type requires them.
  6. Submit and track the approval with the notifications bell.
  7. File the approval letter as a Document Record: Leave and Accommodation Documentation.

IntermittentSeparate blocks for one reason (e.g., treatments)One absence per occurrence, actual time
